items.prompt: The laptop disk is 97% full and the computer feels very slow. The right step is…
choices: Delete temporary files, empty the Recycle Bin, and move large files
Install a cleaner app from an unknown site
items.explanation: A disk above 90% leaves the computer no working space. Clean out unneeded files and move large files to office storage.

items.prompt: The printer stopped working right after its driver was updated yesterday. What do you do?
choices: Leave it, it will fix itself
Roll back the driver to the previous version
items.explanation: A problem that appears right after a driver update is most likely caused by the new driver. Rolling back restores the version that worked before.

items.prompt: Tap the findings that need fixing to keep the laptop secure.

parts.text: The last security update was installed 8 months ago.
The wallpaper shows a beach scene.
A pirated app was installed from a file sent by a friend.

items.explanation: Updates delayed for months leave a gap, and pirated apps can carry malware. The wallpaper and a 45% full disk are fine.

items.prompt: Put the steps for installing a security update in order.
steps: Make sure the computer runs normally
items.explanation: Save your work first because updates usually need a restart. After restarting, check that everything runs normally.

items.prompt: Where should Nusa Digital employees install apps from?
choices: A link sent in a group chat
items.explanation: The office App Portal only has official apps that have been checked. Apps from other sources can carry malware.
